## Question
Are **all T07-ratified lived-image records** developed as full Mytheme pages, with plates/media only where the final census gives them a distinct office?

## Context
Consume the propagated whole-field census, not the historical Mytheme directory as a target inventory. The final quilt now carries a richer candidate field — myths, narrative, poetry, art, music, media and plates including the uroboros/torus/trickster complex, Ares/Aphrodite/Harmonia, Hephaestus, Mother/Assumption/chiasm, Apollo/Dionysus/Daphne, travelling jigsaw, **the mirror that moves first**, Neumann/Job imagery, Taylor poems and Goethe — but each survives, merges or rehomes according to the ratified census rather than this list.

The telling is in our voice and knows the argument across registers. A Mytheme can carry a living image strongly without being made to prove the Matheme or historical source claim it refracts.

Each page begins from raw `#0/#1/#2/#3/#4/#5→0`; its six local meanings are derived from the image/myth/poem and its actual incoming/outgoing relations. There is no universal semantic heading set.

Plates live in `mytheme/plates/` where ratified. Poetry belongs under the actual ratified poetry home; Goethe has a light manuscript office but may receive a rich Mytheme poetry page if the census retains it.

## Done when

Every ratified Mytheme record has one developed page; every declared plate/media asset exists in its proper home; every page has clear return routes into the arguments/Matheme/Episteme it actually serves; source-vs-authorial/mythemic boundaries remain legible; and hygiene + census-backcheck find no missing or historically preserved-by-inertia records.
title: T20 — P2 — mytheme pages + plates
